source.title: Eagle's Fist
source.description:
You find a carefully folded letter inside of the toolbox. Imagining a voice speaking, you read: "From here, with the right tools, you call the shots. Great place to launch a parachute glider.

My loyalty to the Eagle and Fist requires distance in order to serve them best. This barricade has had better days, like the Old Kingdoms it once defended, but I'll never abandon it."
source.objective: Water spray dampens the air, the view is incredible.
source.completion: A campfire is newly fed with wood, but signs of a quick departure are evident.
